scientific_summary: 347063 independent adversarial qualification, Claude Opus 5.5: CREDITABLE SUBJECT TO LEAN AND PAPER for Combine Smallest only, moderate confidence. Literal: FAIL as written, PASS source-bound; the MathDB record says the game starts from the Zeckendorf decomposition, which gives zero moves, while source Definition 1.1 starts from n copies of F_1. Root rules that the record is a transcription defect, that its only coherent reading is the source game, and binds the endpoint to the exact source scope openly, following the accepted_exact_source_scope precedent; correcting the record earns nothing, and the user may rule otherwise. Part (a) SS(n)=phi^2 n + O(log^2 n): mathematics PASS but PUBLIC through Cusenza et al., Fibonacci Quarterly 60(1) (2022), identity (3.16), attributed and uncredited. Part (b) CS(n)=c n + O(sqrt(n) log n), c = 5/2 - phi + sum_{j>=2} 1/F_{2j} = 1.2064812: mathematics PASS with an independent reconstruction; no prior found in a bounded search; no linear potential can count these splits; no reduction to a source theorem found. ROOT RECORDS A PROSPECTIVE SCIENTIFIC PASS for the conjecture as completed by part (b), modest significance, bounded novelty, credit 0 until a literal Lean endpoint, independent formal audit, paper and replay are paid. Strongest objection retained: an elementary count of one deterministic algorithm with half of the conjecture already public. The reviewer found and corrected an endgame error in its own table in PROOF-ERRATUM.md; the author list was right. Limits: no MathSciNet, zbMATH or citation-index coverage. 166 manifest files, 21 frozen bindings, 6 GET successes (all PDF), 2 searches.
